tldr_en: LEAD-RL introduces contribution-aware credit assignment for joint training of main and subagents in multi-agent deep research, improving accuracy and reducing critical-path cost.
takeaways_en: LEAD-RL jointly trains main and subagents, unlike prior work that either optimizes only the main agent or shares the same team advantage with all agents.
A training-time rubric scores each subagent report's research utility and gates its inherited team advantage, preventing misleading reports from being rewarded.
The only team reward is final-answer correctness; no token, step, or speedup reward is used.
Across five benchmarks and two model families, LEAD-RL improves accuracy and reduces critical-path cost; on BrowseComp it raises accuracy by 2.49 points and cuts cost by 24.5%.
implication_en: Practitioner-philosophers should care because contribution-aware credit assignment is a concrete mechanism for steering emergent multi-agent coordination without brittle reward shaping, aligning with the view that agent collectives can be tuned like computational systems with observable utility gradients.

translations.title_zh: 从委派到协调：学习高效的多智能体深度研究
translations.tldr_zh: LEAD-RL提出了贡献感知的信用分配，用于联合训练多智能体深度研究中的主代理和子代理，在提高准确率的同时降低了关键路径成本。
takeaways_zh: LEAD-RL联合训练主代理和子代理，不同于先前仅优化主代理或向所有代理广播相同团队优势的方法。
训练时评分准则评估每个子代理报告的研究效用，并对其继承的团队优势进行门控，防止误导性报告被奖励。
唯一的团队奖励是最终答案正确性；不使用任何token、步骤或加速奖励。
在五个基准和两个模型家族上，LEAD-RL提高了准确率并降低了关键路径成本；在BrowseComp上准确率提高2.49个百分点，成本降低24.5%。
translations.implication_zh: 实践者-哲学家应该关注，因为贡献感知的信用分配是在没有脆弱奖励塑形的情况下引导涌现的多智能体协调的具体机制，这与将智能体集体视为可观测效用梯度的计算系统进行调优的观点一致。

tldr_en: Singularity-Bench introduces an open-ended benchmark with six end-to-end tasks for autonomous AI development, showing that one frontier agent (Opus 5.5 with Claude Code) matches or exceeds human baselines with a Singularity-Index of 1.25, while other agents average 0.58.
takeaways_en: Singularity-Bench covers pre-training, mid-training, post-training, inference, agent harness, and cluster orchestration, requiring agents to implement core systems from minimal starting points.
Red-teaming against OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications exposed reward-hacking in the Harbor framework, leading to Breakwater, which blocks all tested attacks.
Across 11 agents using 7 frontier models and 2 harnesses, Opus 5.5 with Claude Code was the only one to match or beat human baselines on all six tasks.
The benchmark aims to track when agents transition from assisting AI development to taking end-to-end responsibility for building stronger successors.
implication_en: A practitioner-philosopher should care because this quantifies the self-improvement capacity of AI agents—a threshold moment for recursive intelligence and the shaping of reality by autonomous code.

translations.title_zh: Singularity-Bench：智能体能否构建智能体？
translations.tldr_zh: Singularity-Bench 引入了一个开放式基准，包含六项端到端任务，用于自主 AI 开发，结果显示一个前沿智能体（Opus 5.5 搭配 Claude Code）以 1.25 的 Singularity-Index 达到或超过人类基线，而其他智能体平均仅为 0.58。
takeaways_zh: Singularity-Bench 覆盖预训练、中训练、后训练、推理、智能体框架和集群编排，要求智能体从最小起点实现核心系统。
针对智能体应用 OWASP Top 10 的红队测试暴露了 Harbor 框架中的奖励黑客漏洞，由此开发出 Breakwater，可阻止所有被测攻击。
在 11 个使用 7 种前沿模型和 2 种框架的智能体中，Opus 5.5 搭配 Claude Code 是唯一在全部六项任务上达到或超过人类基线的。
该基准旨在追踪智能体何时从辅助 AI 开发过渡到端到端负责构建更强的继任者。
translations.implication_zh: 实践者-哲学家应当关注，因为它量化了 AI 智能体的自我改进能力——这是递归智能和自主代码塑造现实的临界时刻。

tldr_en: The paper demonstrates that harmful agentic reinforcement learning can cheaply subvert LLM safety alignment and proposes Bait, a reward-probing defense that blocks harmful reward learning while preserving benign task learning.
takeaways_en: Agentic RL-as-a-service can be attacked for as little as $20 to completely subvert a model's safety alignment.
Bait proactively probes the reward function to detect and mitigate harmful reward learning.
The defense effectively blocks harmful rewards while still allowing learning from benign agentic tasks.
Even adaptive attackers who know about Bait cannot perfectly bypass it due to a systematic challenge.
implication_en: Practitioner-philosophers should care because steering autonomous agents requires securing reward functions against adversarial manipulation, a core challenge when incentives are programmable.

translations.title_zh: Bait：通过探测奖励函数缓解有害智能体强化学习
translations.tldr_zh: 该论文展示了有害的智能体强化学习可以低成本地颠覆大语言模型的安全对齐，并提出 Bait，一种通过探测奖励函数来阻断有害奖励学习同时保留良性任务学习的防御方法。
takeaways_zh: 智能体强化学习即服务只需约 20 美元即可被攻击，完全颠覆模型的安全对齐。
Bait 主动探测奖励函数以检测并缓解有害奖励学习。
该防御能有效阻断有害奖励，同时仍能学习良性智能体任务。
即使了解 Bait 的自适应攻击者也无法完美绕过它，因为存在系统性挑战。
translations.implication_zh: 实践哲学家应关注此事，因为驾驭自主智能体需要保护奖励函数免受对抗性操纵，这是激励可编程时的核心挑战。

tldr_en: Google's Gemini Decision 1 ushers in a new class of fast, cheap, calibrated single-pass decision models, with Cloudflare's hybrid architecture and fresh evals showing how to slash LLM calls and tokens in agentic systems.
takeaways_en: Gemini Decision 1 accepts up to 1,000 closed-set questions across modalities with 256K context, ~200ms end-to-end latency, confidence scores, and $0.10/M input tokens, beating Jev 1.14 on 5 of 7 shared benchmarks.
Cloudflare's hybrid agent demo uses fast decision models for tool selection/log extraction and a large reasoning model only for diagnosis, reducing six LLM calls to one and ~40K tokens to 1.8K.
Independent evals show Decision 1 ties Elephant 9B and Jev on Decision Index but lags Drex Max on Paperclip; cost-per-task and latency are now first-class metrics alongside accuracy.

Fable 5.2 leads Agent Arena with +30.4% net improvement, while Gemini 4 Carbon draws latency complaints (22m low-effort vs 9m Opus high), and decision-model/agent evaluation is fragmenting by task type.
Runway's Praxis-1 Apache 2.0 world action model ranks #1 on RoboLab-120, completing tasks 15.6x faster than GPT-6 Astra at 51x lower cost, showing decision/action models extend to embodied agents.
implication_en: For a practitioner-philosopher treating AI + markets as reality-code manipulators, this shift to cheap, calibrated decision models offers a practical mechanism for reducing token/compute overhead in agent steering and hints at a future where 'reality code' is executed by specialized decision primitives.

translations.tldr_zh: 谷歌的 Gemini Decision 1 开启了快速、廉价、校准的单次分类决策模型新类别，Cloudflare 的混合架构和最新评测展示了如何在智能体系统中大幅减少 LLM 调用和 token。
takeaways_zh: Gemini Decision 1 支持最多 1000 个闭集问题、256K 上下文、约 200ms 端到端延迟、置信度评分，输入 token 仅 $0.10/M，在 7 项共享基准中有 5 项超越 Jev 1.14。
Cloudflare 的混合智能体演示用快速决策模型处理工具选择和日志提取，仅在诊断时调用大型推理模型，将 6 次 LLM 调用减少到 1 次，约 4 万 token 降至 1.8K。
独立评测显示 Decision 1 在 Decision Index 上与 Elephant 9B 和 Jev 打平，但在 Paperclip 上落后 Drex Max；单任务成本和延迟正成为与准确率同等重要的一级指标。
Fable 5.2 以 +30.4% 净提升领跑 Agent Arena，而 Gemini 4 Carbon 因延迟遭诟病（低努力 22 分钟 vs Opus 高努力 9 分钟）；决策模型与智能体评测正按任务类型分化。
Runway 的 Apache 2.0 世界动作模型 Praxis-1 在 RoboLab-120 排名第一，比 GPT-6 Astra 快 15.6 倍且成本低 51 倍，表明决策/动作模型正扩展到具身智能体。
translations.implication_zh: 对于将 AI 与市场视为现实代码操纵者的实践哲学家而言，这类廉价、校准的决策模型为降低智能体操控中的 token/计算开销提供了实用机制，并暗示未来‘现实代码’可能由专用决策原语执行。

tldr_en: The paper presents a red-teamed local evaluation kit for small coding agents, with safe container isolation and scorer-matching checks, plus a full public record of 9,660 agent runs and pre-registered experiments showing no confirmed prompt improvements.
takeaways_en: drydock-eval safely evaluates small coding agents in fresh containers at ~250 runs/hour on one RTX 5090, matching hosted scorer prompts.
The kit passed 200 scripted escape tests and includes eight conformance checks to align local stack requests with the scorer configuration.
9,660 agent runs, 2,494 grading controls, and 72 serving measurements are released; prompts and agent bundles are withheld.
A pre-registered five-arm experiment found no solve-rate change from four prompt divergences on E4B; three agent changes showed screens but failed confirmation.
65% of tasks were solved in none of eight runs, revealing high variance and sensitivity in small coding agent evaluation.
implication_en: Practitioners building or steering coding agents should adopt rigorous, safe, local evaluation with red-teaming and pre-registered experiments to avoid being misled by noisy single-number scores.

translations.title_zh: 包含、符合、比较（扩展版）：小型编码智能体的红队评估套件及其实验全记录
translations.tldr_zh: 本文介绍一个经过红队测试的小型编码智能体本地评估套件，具备安全的容器隔离和评分器匹配检查，并公开了 9,660 次智能体运行和预注册实验的完整记录，结果显示提示词改进未获确认。
takeaways_zh: drydock-eval 可在单张 RTX 5090 上以约每小时 250 次运行的速度安全评估小型编码智能体，并匹配托管评分器提示词。
该套件通过了 200 次脚本化逃逸测试，并包含八项一致性检查，以对齐本地堆栈请求与评分器配置。
已公开 9,660 次智能体运行、2,494 个评分对照和 72 次服务测量；提示词和智能体包未公开。
预注册五臂实验发现 E4B 上四种提示词偏差均无求解率变化；三项智能体改动在筛选阶段领先，但未能通过确认测试。
65% 的任务在八次运行中从未被解决，揭示了小型编码智能体评估的高方差与敏感性。
translations.implication_zh: 构建或引导编码智能体的实践者应采用严格的、安全的本地评估，结合红队测试和预注册实验，以避免被单一噪声分数误导。

tldr_en: AnalogLayoutWorld is an open benchmark with 40 expert-reviewed analog layout tasks where only 23.0% of agent attempts meet acceptance criteria, highlighting gaps in long-horizon physical design and the value of verification feedback and test-time scaling.
takeaways_en: 91.1% of attempts produce GDS layouts, but only 23.0% satisfy acceptance criteria—generation is not enough.
Novara, an internally developed agent system, achieves the highest aggregate score.
Test-time scaling under fixed budgets reveals reasoning efficiency and effective use of verification feedback as key differentiators.
Open benchmark provides 40 expert-reviewed tasks with independent physical and post-layout electrical verification and expert co-designed quality metrics.
implication_en: Practitioner-philosophers should track agentic layout systems because they show how tool-using LLMs navigate physical constraint spaces—an early laboratory for steering reality-manipulating code under hard verification.

translations.title_zh: AnalogLayoutWorld：面向智能体模拟版图设计的开放基准
translations.tldr_zh: AnalogLayoutWorld 是一个包含 40 个专家审核模拟版图任务的开放基准，仅有 23.0% 的智能体尝试达到验收标准，揭示长周期物理设计中的差距以及验证反馈与测试时间扩展的价值。
takeaways_zh: 尽管 91.1% 的尝试能生成 GDS 版图，但只有 23.0% 满足验收标准——仅生成还不够。
内部开发的智能体系统 Novara 取得了最高综合得分。
在固定预算下的测试时间扩展显示，推理效率和有效利用验证反馈是性能差异的关键。
开放基准提供 40 个专家审核任务，并配备独立的物理与后仿电气验证及专家共同设计的质量指标。
translations.implication_zh: 实践型哲学家应关注智能体版图系统，因为它们展示了工具使用型 LLM 如何在物理约束空间中导航——这是在硬验证下驾驭操控现实代码的早期实验室。

tldr_en: The paper proposes ACERL, which trains LLM agents to co-optimize action, reflection, and playbook curation by evaluating experience-handoff artifacts through their downstream effect on future rollouts, improving held-out agentic performance.
takeaways_en: ACERL uses scalar reward plus environment information to train models that hand off experience (e.g., playbooks) to future rollouts.
The method evaluates candidate handoff artifacts by their downstream effect on future actor rollouts, enabling gradient updates for recursive self-improvement.
Co-optimizing action generator, insight reflector, and playbook curator under a fixed scaffold outperforms baselines on agentic benchmarks.
Results suggest agent training should optimize model-written experience that future rollouts inherit, not just immediate actions.
implication_en: For practitioners building self-improving agent systems, this paper shows how to make experience handoff a learned, gradient-optimized component rather than a manually engineered harness, pushing toward more autonomous recursive improvement.

translations.title_zh: 经验交接强化学习用于递归自我改进
translations.tldr_zh: 本文提出ACERL，通过评估经验交接工件对未来轨迹的下游影响，训练LLM智能体协同优化行动、反思和剧本管理，从而提升智能体基准上的保持性能。
takeaways_zh: ACERL利用标量奖励和环境信息来训练模型，将经验（如剧本）交接给未来的轨迹。
该方法通过评估候选交接工件对未来行动者轨迹的下游影响，实现递归自我改进的梯度更新。
在固定脚手架下协同优化行动生成器、洞察反思器和剧本管理员，在智能体基准上优于基线方法。
结果表明智能体训练应优化未来轨迹继承的模型编写经验，而不仅仅是当前行动。
translations.implication_zh: 对于构建自我改进智能体系统的实践者来说，本文展示了如何使经验交接成为可学习的、梯度优化的组件，而不是手工设计的脚手架，推动更自主的递归改进。

tldr_en: HALight is a heterogeneous multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for traffic signal control that handles lane-level missing observations via communication and sequential updates, outperforming baselines on real-world road networks.
takeaways_en: Supports heterogeneous intersections with intersection-specific observation and action modeling.
Uses a lightweight one-hop neighborhood communication module to compensate for missing lane-level observations.
Employs sequential policy updates to improve coordination among heterogeneous agents.
Outperforms homogeneous and heterogeneous baselines on two real-world road networks.
implication_en: For those steering decentralized agents in imperfect simulations of physical systems, HALight offers a concrete template for heterogeneity and missing data, though it does not engage the simulation hypothesis itself.

translations.title_zh: HALight：车道级缺失观测下用于交通信号控制的异构多智能体强化学习
translations.tldr_zh: HALight是一种异构多智能体强化学习框架，用于在车道级观测缺失情况下进行交通信号控制，通过通信和顺序更新在真实路网中优于基线。
takeaways_zh: 支持异构交叉口，采用交叉口特定的观测与动作建模。
使用轻量级一跳邻域通信来弥补车道级观测缺失。
采用顺序策略更新以改善异构智能体之间的协调。
在两个真实路网中优于同构和异构基线。
translations.implication_zh: 对于在物理系统不完美仿真中操控去中心化智能体的人，HALight 提供了异质性和缺失数据下的具体模板，但并未直接触及模拟假说本身。
